integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from rank-local consequences explicitly established in the cited source plus a classical Haar projection beta identity. No numerical experiment or inaccessible source is used to certify the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Requires approximate conditional isotropy through a radial reduction and all deterministic orientations at one fixed proportional rank; does not solve arbitrary-tail radius identification without that structure and gives no finite-dimensional rate.
title: One fixed projection rank identifies arbitrary-tail radii under approximate conditional isotropy
